ops.note: Her nisba 'Ben al-Raḥbī' (zinger_princet p. 421) points to al-Raḥba on the Euphrates, the well-known town, not the Lebanese village PGP defines as Raḥba.

props.evidence: Sittūna bt. Ḥayyīm b. Solomon, known as Ben al-Raḥbī, came to court to nominate a representative to sue her husband, Faraḥ b. Joseph, known as Ben Bānūqa, who had abandoned her years ago without maintenance.
